checklist: Auto from the RAW (BRIDGE-v0.02 §1, prompts/PROMPT-auto-backend.md): lumina.auto(rel) answers AutoDevelop's {look, version} for real ARWs in the Edit page's slider units, the same answer twice (cached per file + version), null for a path that was not read; and in the app, A in Edit applies it and the footer says "Auto · …", never "Auto (estimate)". Folder: LUMINA_EDIT_DIR (probe.sh auto sets it).

steps.js: const P = __probe.logic().real.slice(0, 5); const out = []; for (const p of P) { const r = await lumina.auto(p.path); const L = r && r.look; out.push(!!L && typeof r.version === 'string' && r.version.length > 0 && typeof L.ev === 'number' && L.ev >= -5 && L.ev <= 5 && Math.abs(L.ev * 20 - Math.round(L.ev * 20)) < 1e-9 && ['hl','sh','wh','bl'].every(k => typeof L[k] === 'number' && L[k] >= -100 && L[k] <= 100 && L[k] === Math.round(L[k])) && (L.wb == null || (L.wb >= 2500 && L.wb <= 10000 && L.tint >= -150 && L.tint <= 150))); } return out.length > 0 && out.every(Boolean)
steps.what: lumina.auto answers {look, version} for real ARWs, in slider units (ev on the 0.05 step, tones whole numbers in −100 … 100, wb 2500 … 10000 K with its tint)

steps.src: const P = __probe.logic().real.slice(0, 5); const out = {}; for (const p of P) out[p.path.split('/').pop()] = await lumina.auto(p.path); window.__autoFirst = out; return JSON.stringify(out)
